Stadiums are the cathedrals of sport — concrete memory banks where generations experienced the same joys and heartbreaks. This database covers the ground's history, architecture, great events, and how to visit it.

title: History
d: Centre Court Wimbledon opened in 1922. Tennis's most famous court..
definition: Centre Court Wimbledon opened in 1922. Tennis's most famous court..
description: The history of Centre Court Wimbledon begins in 1922. Tennis's most famous court. Like all great grounds, it has been rebuilt, renamed, and reborn — stands rising where terraces stood, roofs arriving decades after the first kick. Its timeline is the timeline of its tenants' triumphs and the city's love affair with the game.
